sections.label: Global growth and Singapore restructuring
sections.summary: Weaker global growth from slower G3 recovery and moderating China growth, but ASEAN growth and restructuring can position Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: The confluence of a slower than expected recovery of the G3 economies and the moderation of growth in China has resulted in weaker global economic growth.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: Against this backdrop, there are pockets of opportunities that Singapore can continue to exploit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: The ASEAN economies are expected to continue to grow, driven by a rising growing middle class.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: To position Singapore for the future, we must persevere with restructuring to enhance our companies' capabilities and our people's skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: At the same time, developing growth clusters will keep Singapore resilient amidst slower global economic growth and create good jobs that provide opportunities for Singaporeans.

sections.label: RIE 2020 innovation-led growth
sections.summary: Under RIE 2020 plans, MTI will partner NRF to leverage R&D for innovation-led enterprise growth.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: Under the Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE) 2020 plans, MTI will partner the National Research Foundation (NRF) to leverage R&D to support innovation-led growth for our enterprises.

sections.label: TPP, AEC, FTAs, Enterprise Development Fund
sections.summary: TPP, ASEAN Economic Community and expanding FTAs mean lower tariffs and market access; MTI supports internationalisation via Enterprise Development Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: The Trans-Pacific 	Page: 53 Partnership (TPP), ASEAN Economic Community and our expanding network of FTAs will mean lower tariffs, improved market access and greater transparency for companies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: MTI will also support companies in developing capabilities to internationalise through the expanded Enterprise Development Fund.
